ext.description: Aligns crontab files into clean columns. Native Format Document / Format Selection / Format on Save, soft validation, schedule explanations and safe quick fixes.

config.title: Crontab Formatter
config.mode.desc:
Which crontab layout to align to.

- `user` — five time fields then the command: `MIN HOUR DOM MON DOW COMMAND`.
- `system` — adds a **USER** column before the command (`/etc/crontab`, `cron.d`).
- `auto` — picks one by looking at the file name and contents.
config.mode.enum.auto: Detect from the file name and contents.
config.mode.enum.user: User crontab: MIN HOUR DOM MON DOW COMMAND.
config.mode.enum.system: System crontab: adds a USER column (e.g. /etc/crontab, cron.d).
config.secondsField.desc:
Treat the first column as a **seconds** field (6/7-field cron, e.g. Quartz). Leave off for standard crontab.

`auto` currently behaves as **off** so it never breaks a normal file.
config.secondsField.enum.auto: Off for now — kept safe for standard crontab.
config.secondsField.enum.true: Always treat the leading column as seconds.
config.secondsField.enum.false: Never treat the leading column as seconds.
config.yearField.desc:
Treat the last schedule column as a **year** field (7-field cron).

`auto` currently behaves as **off**.
config.yearField.enum.true: Always expect a trailing year column.
config.yearField.enum.false: Never expect a trailing year column.
config.alignComments.desc: Pull a safe trailing comment (a `#` that is **outside** quotes) into its own aligned column. Comments that are part of the command are left untouched.
config.alignRedirects.desc: Line up the redirection tail (`>`, `>>`, `2>&1`) in its own column so you can see at a glance where each job sends its output.
config.alignEnvEquals.desc: Align environment assignments such as `PATH=…` / `MAILTO=…` on the `=` sign.
config.insertHeader.desc: Insert a reminder line `# min hour day month weekday command` at the top of the file. Extra columns (seconds, year, user) are added when their settings are enabled.
config.preserveIndentation.desc: Keep each line's existing leading spaces. Off (default) aligns every column from the left edge.
config.minSpacesBetweenColumns.desc: How many spaces to leave between aligned columns. Minimum `1`; default `2`.
config.formatMacros.desc: Also align macro lines (`@reboot`, `@daily`, `@hourly`, …) among themselves. Macros form their own column, separate from regular cron schedules.
config.validateOnSave.desc: Run soft diagnostics (out-of-range fields, `*/0`, reversed ranges, unknown macros, missing user, missing redirect), refreshed while editing and on open/save. These are hints/warnings only — they never block formatting.
config.explainHover.desc: When you hover over a schedule, show a plain-language description of when it runs (powered by cronstrue).
config.locale.desc:
Language for this extension's own messages, hints and hover explanations.

- `en` — English (default).
- `ru` — Russian.
- `auto` — follow the VS Code display language.

Note: the **settings descriptions** on this page follow the VS Code display language, not this option.
config.locale.enum.auto: Follow the VS Code display language.
